package.name: Rotary Moulder Workbench
package.description: Design rotary cookie moulder drums for industrial biscuit and cracker production. Wraps flat cookie outlines (via Sketch_On_Surface) onto a cylindrical drum and cuts drafted cavities. Supports engraved/embossed text and shape details, perforation pins (docker pins), and patterning around the drum (linear or alternating layout).
package.author: Mike Passchier
Claude.ai (Anthropic)
